tr_h_list: When a valid user submits a POST request to /auth/login, the system shall authenticate the user.
When a user submits a POST request to /auth/login with an invalid username, the system shall return an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response.
When a user submits a POST request to /auth/login without a TOTP code, the system shall not authenticate the user.
When a user submits a POST request to /auth/login with an expired refresh token, the system shall not issue new access and refresh tokens.
When a user authentication attempt occurs, the system shall record an audit log entry.
When a valid refresh token is submitted, the system shall issue new access and refresh tokens.
When an invalid TOTP code is submitted, the system shall not authenticate the user.
When client initiates communication, the system shall use TLS 1.2 or higher.
When access token is generated, the system shall sign it using RS256 algorithm.
When user submits password, the system shall check it meets complexity requirements within 12 characters.
When audit log record is generated, the system shall retain it for at least 90 days.
When invalid credentials are submitted, the system shall respond with error within 1 second.
When user exceeds 5 consecutive failed login attempts, the system shall lock account for at least 15 minutes.
When account is locked, the system shall unlock it within 15 minutes.
When client exceeds 10 requests per minute, the system shall respond with error within 1 second.
When access token is issued, the system shall expire it within 15 minutes.
When invalid submitted credentials are provided, the system shall respond with an authentication failure message.
When 5 consecutive failed login attempts occur, the system shall lock the account for 15 minutes.
The system shall unlock the account within 15 minutes after being locked due to excessive failed login attempts.
When the client IP address exceeds 10 requests per minute, the system shall respond with a rate limit exceeded message.
The system shall invalidate access tokens within 15 minutes after issuance.
When Registered User requests new access token, the AuthController shall respond with a new access token.
When AuthController detects failed login attempts, the AuthController shall lock the user account.
When AuthController detects a locked account, the AuthController shall automatically unlock the account.
When Rate Limiter detects excessive login attempts, the Rate Limiter shall block further login attempts.
When AuthController processes a login request, the AuthController shall record an audit log entry.
When Unauthenticated Client requests authentication, the AuthController shall validate the client credentials.
When Registered User requests new access token, the AuthController shall validate the refresh token.
When AuthController detects a locked account, the AuthController shall prevent further login attempts.
When Rate Limiter detects a blocked IP address, the Rate Limiter shall prevent further login attempts from that IP address.
